High | Links | asset.parent_asset_id → location | Link rule was never checked for older rows | The rule "every parent_asset_id must exist in location" was added with NOT VALID. New rows are checked, but rows that already existed were never checked and may point to nothing. | Count the rows that break the rule. If there are none, run: ALTER TABLE public.asset VALIDATE CONSTRAINT asset_parent_fkey;
Blocking | Links | asset.parent_asset_id → location | Link probably points to the wrong table | From its name, parent_asset_id should point to asset. The rule makes it point to location instead. Real asset IDs will be rejected, so this link cannot be used. | Check with the team, then drop the rule "asset_parent_fkey" and recreate it with REFERENCES asset.
Low | Speed | asset: asset_type_id, location_id, parent_asset_id | 3 links have no index | Joins over these links and deletes of the linked rows get slow as the table grows. | Add an index on asset_type_id, location_id, parent_asset_id.
Medium | Time | asset | Two kinds of time in one table | Some time columns store a time zone and some do not. It is like writing one time in local time and another in UTC. | Use timestamp with time zone everywhere, or document which zone the others use.
Low | Speed | capability: asset_type_id | A link has no index | Joins over these links and deletes of the linked rows get slow as the table grows. | Add an index on asset_type_id.
Medium | Duplicates | person.orcid | Identifier can be duplicated | orcid is the kind of value that should identify one record, but the database allows the same value twice. | Check for duplicates, then add a unique rule on orcid.
Low | Speed | session_person: person_id, session_id | 2 links have no index | Joins over these links and deletes of the linked rows get slow as the table grows. | Add an index on person_id, session_id.
Low | Naming | asset.end | Names that need quotes in SQL | These names are reserved words in SQL. Every query must write them in double quotes, which is easy to forget. | Rename them when convenient, or always quote them.
Info | Content | asset, asset_type, capability, location, person, session, session_person | 7 tables are empty | These tables have no rows (according to database statistics), so there is nothing to migrate from them right now. | Confirm they are unused before planning work on them.
Low | Descriptions | 2 of 7 tables, 1 of 35 columns | Descriptions on 3% of columns | Few columns explain what they mean. People have to guess, and matching with another database gets harder. | Add COMMENT ON COLUMN for the important columns, starting with the ones you migrate.
